description: Write the servicePrincipalName attribute of a target user to enable a targeted Kerberoast.

telemetry.detail: servicePrincipalName write logged under DS-change auditing (default OFF).
TGS-REQ for the injected SPN - watch RC4 (0x17) service tickets.
Add-SPN-then-roast-then-clear is a recognised pattern; single-SPN roast otherwise blends with TGS volume.

prerequisite_privilege: WriteProperty on the target's servicePrincipalName (or GenericWrite/GenericAll)
abuse_primitive: Set an SPN, request its TGS, crack offline, clear the SPN.
notes: Comparable to GenericWrite's roast path. The single targeted TGS is hard to distinguish from normal Kerberos activity.
